summary: Use the smallest correct change after understanding the real code path.
instructions: Before adding code, check in order: unnecessary, existing implementation, standard library, native platform, installed dependency, then the minimum new implementation.
Prefer deleting, reusing, or extending one owner over adding wrappers, parallel frameworks, compatibility shells, or speculative abstractions.
Do not minimize away validation, data-loss protection, security boundaries, accessibility, measurement correctness, or hardware safety.
New dependencies require a concrete capability gap and lifecycle owner.
